title: data(wood): CIRAD Tropix shrinkage for 10 species that had none (batch 2)
intent: Add tangential/radial shrinkage to 10 wood_species.json records that had no shrinkage value, from CIRAD Tropix species sheets (policy priority 2, added by PR #489), for species with no FPL GTR-282 Table 4-3/4-4 row. One sheet at a time, cited per value; each sheet's botanical list checked against the record's scientific name.
behavior_change: wood_movement_calc now returns results for cumaru, makore, bloodwood, yellowheart, tatajuba, mango, cerejeira, garapa, timborana and sucupira; it previously raised ValueError for them because they had no shrinkage (supported species 47 -> 57). No code, route or schema change; no existing value changed.

diff_articulation.what_changed: wood_species.json: 10 records gain contraction_tangential_pct / contraction_radial_pct, each with _shrinkage_<dir>_source CIRAD_Tropix, _shrinkage_<dir>_url and _shrinkage_<dir>_sheet_date. VERIFICATION_LOG: C-15 (values, sheet dates, botanical lists, findings) and O-12 updated.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These species had no shrinkage at all, so the wood-movement calculator could not be used for them; FPL Tables 4-3/4-4 do not cover them.

commands_run: json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) reproduces origin/main's wood_species.json byte-for-byte before editing
scripted diff vs origin/main: _meta and all other fields identical; only the 10 records changed, each only by adding 8 shrinkage/provenance keys; no existing key changed
each sheet's botanical list contains the record's species (asserted); St/Sr agrees with the sheet's printed ratio within rounding for all 10
FPL CSV checked: no Table 4-3/4-4 row for any of the 10 species (FPL 'Sucupira' is Diplotropis purpurea, not Bowdichia nitida)
wood_movement_calc.get_shrinkage_data returns the new values for all 10; list_species() = 57

py -3.11 -m pytest tests/test_wood_movement_calc.py tests/test_silent_fallback_elimination.py tests/test_finish_calc.py tests/test_inverse_brace_sizing.py tests/test_registry_endpoint_smoke.py: 96 passed

files.intent: C-15 record of the 10 additions with sheet dates and botanical lists; snakewood exclusion (sheet is Zygia racemosa, record is Brosimum guianense); trade-group limitations; O-12 updated.
Tropix tangential/radial shrinkage with per-field attribution for 10 species that had none.
files.behavior_change: wood_movement_calc accepts these 10 species instead of raising ValueError.

risk_rationale: Low: additive data only, no existing value changed, no code change. Known limitations: cumaru, mango, sucupira and timborana take trade-group sheet averages applied to single-species records; Tropix values are averages, not per-board measurements.
